title: Complete characterization of disconnected one-point unions of cycles with local antimagic chromatic number 2
summary: A graph $G = (V, E)$ that admits a bijective edge labeling $f:E \to\{1,\ldots ,|E|\}$ is local antimagic if $f$ induces a vertex labeling $f^+$ such that for any pair of adjacent vertices $x$ and $y$, $f^+(x)\not= f^+(y)$, where the induced vertex label $f^+(x)= \sum f(xu)$, with $u$ ranging over all the vertices adjacent to $x$. The minimum number of distinct induced vertex labels over all local antimagic labelings of $G$ is the local antimagic chromatic number of $G$, denoted $χ_{la}(G)$.
